answer: Bindings are kept in shale, verified in zenith, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the orchard check. A farm of 4721 identities would post 4184 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
